text: The Patriots are navigating a bruising injury week following their dominant Week 5 victory over the Raiders, with left tackle Will Campbell sidelined by an MCL sprain in his right knee and running back TreVeyon Henderson expected to miss multiple weeks with a high ankle sprain—though quarterback Drake Maye appears to have found his rhythm after a shaky start, as evidenced by his strong performance in the win. On the positive front, cornerback Christian Gonzalez declared himself ready to return after missing the past two games with a shoulder injury, and wide receiver Brown has returned to practice, while the team bolstered its depth chart by signing running back Hassan Haskins and cornerback D'Shawn Jamison to the practice squad while releasing linebacker Jose Ramirez. The Patriots will host the New York Jets at Gillette Stadium on Sunday, October 18 at 1 PM ET as they continue their campaign despite the mounting roster challenges.
